markets.title: Will the Fed cut rates by 25bps at the October 2026 meeting?
markets.rules_primary: If the Federal Reserve cuts the upper bound of the federal funds target range by exactly 25 bps at its meeting concluding Oct 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Source: Federal Reserve FOMC statement. If the meeting is postponed beyond Nov 15, 2026, the market resolves based on the next scheduled meeting.

markets.title: Will the Fed cut rates by 50bps at the October 2026 meeting?
markets.rules_primary: If the Federal Reserve cuts by exactly 50 bps at its meeting concluding Oct 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will the Fed hold rates at the October 2026 meeting?
markets.rules_primary: If the Federal Reserve leaves the target range unchanged at its meeting concluding Oct 28, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Kansas City at Buffalo Winner?
markets.rules_primary: If Kansas City wins the Kansas City at Buffalo professional football game originally scheduled for Oct 12, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The outcome includes overtime. If the game ends in a tie, the market resolves to the last traded price. If the game is postponed and not played within two weeks, the market resolves to No.

markets.title: Kansas City at Buffalo Winner?
markets.rules_primary: If Buffalo wins the Kansas City at Buffalo professional football game originally scheduled for Oct 12, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The outcome includes overtime. If the game ends in a tie, the market resolves to the last traded price.

events.title: Who will win the Ohio Senate race in 2026?

markets.title: Will Jane Doe win the Ohio Senate race in 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If Jane Doe is certified as the winner of the 2026 Ohio Senate election, then the market resolves to Yes. Source: Associated Press call, confirmed by certification.

markets.title: Will John Roe win the Ohio Senate race in 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If John Roe is certified as the winner of the 2026 Ohio Senate election, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will CPI be above 3.0% in September 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the year-over-year change in CPI-U for September 2026, as first released by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, is above 3.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will CPI be above 3.5% in September 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the year-over-year change in CPI-U for September 2026 is above 3.5%, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will Bitcoin be above $120,000 on Oct 31, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the CF Benchmarks Bitcoin Real Time Index (BRTI) 60-second average before 5 PM ET on Oct 31, 2026 is above $120,000, then the market resolves to Yes.

markets.title: Will Bitcoin be above $130,000 on Oct 31, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If BRTI is above $130,000, then the market resolves to Yes.
